|rulings=* USED function works at the following locations: Any Cloud City site, any system (including [[Bespin]]), and any cloud sector connected to Cloud City or [[Bespin]] (including [[Bespin: Cloud City]]). It does not work at any asteroid sectors.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Rescue%20In%20The%20Clouds%20%28V%29</ref>
* The first function works against [[Gravity Shadow]] only if [[Gravity Shadow]] was targeting a pilot character (not a permanent pilot).
* The second function plays during the weapons segment, scheduling the 'battle destiny if unable to otherwise' for later.
* Generally, a destiny draw is targeting ability or defense value if it is used in a comparison or calculation involving ability or defense value. However, RITCv does not combo 'offensively' with [[Wookiee Strangle]] or other cards that cause both players to draw destiny.
* This card does not cancel a [[Hidden Weapons]] destiny draw.
